I couldn't find the dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups, and I've told Marcus that in his DM.

None of them mention Thornbury, and the share has no account files for it. I didn't use the cross-channel message search, because it would also return conversations Marcus isn't part of.

In my reply I suggested he check email or the carrier's paperwork, and offered to note the dock if he tells me which one it is.
